t: 邦妮·查理王子占领了斯特林.
dz: 第二次雅各派崛起:邦妮·查理王子占领了斯特林.
de: Second Jacobite rising: Bonnie Prince Charlie occupies Stirling.

t: 库洛登战役由法国支持的雅各布派和由坎伯兰公爵威廉·奥古斯都所指挥的英国汉诺威军队在苏格兰展开.
te: The Battle of Culloden is fought between the French-supported Jacobites and the British Hanoverian forces commanded by …
dz: 库洛登战役由法国支持的雅各布派和由坎伯兰公爵威廉·奥古斯都所指挥的英国汉诺威军队在苏格兰展开.
de: The Battle of Culloden is fought between the French-supported Jacobites and the British Hanoverian forces commanded by William Augustus, Duke of Cumberland, in Scotland.

t: 奥地利和撒丁岛在皮亚琴察战役中击败了法西联军。
te: Austria and Sardinia defeat a Franco-Spanish army at the Battle of Piacenza.
dz: 奥地利王位继承战争：奥地利和撒丁岛在皮亚琴察战役中击败了法西联军。
de: War of the Austrian Succession: Austria and Sardinia defeat a Franco-Spanish army at the Battle of Piacenza.

t: 克登条约结束了奥斯曼-波斯战争(1743–1746).
te: The Treaty of Kerden concludes the Ottoman–Persian War (1743–1746).
dz: 克登条约结束了奥斯曼-波斯战争(1743–1746).
de: The Treaty of Kerden concludes the Ottoman–Persian War (1743–1746).

t: 新泽西学院(后更名为普林斯顿大学)接收其章程.
te: The College of New Jersey (later renamed Princeton University) receives its charter.
dz: 新泽西学院(后更名为普林斯顿大学)接收其章程.
de: The College of New Jersey (later renamed Princeton University) receives its charter.

t: 1746年利马-卡拉奥地震在秘鲁造成高达6000人死亡,是其历史上最致命的地震.
te: The 1746 Lima–Callao earthquake causes up to 6,000 deaths in Peru, the deadliest in its history up to that point.
dz: 1746年利马-卡拉奥地震在秘鲁造成高达6000人死亡,是其历史上最致命的地震.
de: The 1746 Lima–Callao earthquake causes up to 6,000 deaths in Peru, the deadliest in its history up to that point.
